topic_title: Legal Speed Limits for Texas Roadways & Beaches
prompt: Under what authority can minimum speed limit signs (e.g. 45 MPH) be established on Texas freeways?

options.text: Private trucking companies to ensure commercial freight arrival schedules
Homeowner associations along neighborhood collector street thoroughfares
TxDOT and local authorities when slow speeds consistently impede flow and safety
Minimum speed limits are unconstitutional and prohibited throughout Texas
